requests.request: After all five Website handoffs are integrated and independently verified, provide a bounded single-use preview and production release authority with exact candidate, current target and rollback target.
Provide non-secret receipt identifiers for the official-domain Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster properties plus approved sitemap and IndexNow submission evidence.
Provide accepted production monitoring, alert routing, incident ownership, retention, support escalation and status-page receipt identifiers without exposing credentials.
Provide a safe non-production target and bounded authority for capacity measurement plus backup/restore and rollback drills.
